text:
jordan: Heads-up new layout iteration for Alerting SLO editor. Main changes: compact ribbon for thresholds, a 'snooze' chip for channels, and an inline small-preview to the right of the selector. Figma: https://figma.com/file/new-alert-ui. Quick thoughts? priya: The compact ribbon reads cleaner. One worry: the threshold help copy is still ambiguous for derived metrics. Current: 'percentage of errors' -> maybe: 'Percent of requests failing (window: 5m)'. For derived metrics add 'use metric.field in expressions'. ben: Agree on copy. Also UX nit: the snooze chip uses only color to indicate state. Add text label '(suppressed)' and a :zzz: micro-icon so it's not color-only. sam: Accessibility: our amber warning token is 3.2:1 on white for body text. We need to bump to 4.5:1 or introduce a darker outline for small labels. I can post token swaps shortly. jordan: Good. For the preview, I experimented with placing a tiny interactive pill to the right of the channels that opens a flyout. It summarizes delivery counts: '1/4 active 2 suppressed'. On mobile collapse to '1 active 2 sup.'. priya: Love the summary pill. Suggest the flyout also shows suppression reasons and ETA. Keep the main label short. ben: Keyboard flow: the pill group must support arrow nav, Home/End, and Enter to toggle. Use role=\"listbox\" and option semantics. Example snippet for components team: ```
``` sam: Also ensure the preview flyout is keyboard-dismissable with Esc and that focus returns to the preview pill. aria-bot: Accessibility reminder: any modal/flyout must set role=\"dialog\" or role=\"region\" appropriately, set aria-modal=\"true\" for modal, trap focus, and announce via aria-live polite e.g., 'Notification preview opened'. jordan: Copy question: SLO label 'Target' vs 'SLO target (%)' in compact mode. Priya, product prefers shorter. priya: Keep 'Target' visually and use a tooltip 'Target (%)' on hover. Less noise. ben: Micro style: token chips look vertically misaligned with line inputs. Increase chip min-height to 28px and adjust baseline so text sits aligned. Also add a 2px focus ring in brand-500 for keyboard focus. jordan: Mobile spacing note: the numeric stepper is touching the label; add 6px left gap when width <= 480px. sam: I'll do a contrast sweep and post updated color tokens. ben can we get component semantics PR for pills + focus ring? ben: Yup, I'll open a PR with keyboard nav and sr-only text within the component library. priya: I'll update figma with compact ribbon + snooze chip states and write the short helptext variants for derived metrics. jordan: Plan: priya updates figma by EOD, ben PR for accessibility semantics, sam posts color tokens, i'll draft rollout notes and UX rationale. Target small canary next week. Thanks :thumbsup:
